Hub hold-up review. First an aside: C1 at 4700 uF initially looked undersized for the
flash-flush hold-up against the LDO load -- but checking section 2.7, the sizing was bench-derived
for exactly that flush window, so that concern is dismissed and is not a finding. The actual
subject: the D1 Schottky isolating the +5V_HOLD reservoir is SB120 as built, with SS14 named as
the drop-in higher-margin alternative; both are fine on the 5 V rail, no action needed.

## Conclusions
Hold-up subsystem accepted: C1 sizing is per the bench-derived section 2.7 window and the D1
Schottky choice is within margin. No findings.

12VHPWR temperature sensing pass. Aside first: TH1 placement next to the shunt row briefly
read as a hotspot-coupling mistake -- but that adjacency is the design intent (board/shunt temp is
the point, TH2 carries ambient), so dismissed, not a finding. The real check: the v3.7 NTC dividers
land on ADC2 IO13 and IO14 and both nets are present in the netlist with the 10k legs sourced.

## Conclusions
Temperature sensing wiring is correct: TH1/TH2 dividers reach IO13/IO14 as designed. Accept with
no findings; TH1-by-the-shunt is intentional.
